name: Father Martin
role: Catholic priest from Mandan who said mass in Medora
bio: Father Martin was a Catholic priest from Mandan who came to Medora regularly from July 1884 to say mass, first at George Fitzgerald's, the Marquis de Mores's residence and the Pyramid Park hotel. In the fall of 1884 he reported on the Sisters' Hospital being built at Mandan, and in November he blessed the Catholic church erected by the Marquise de Mores. That December he circulated a petition for a town library and arranged for its books. He married several Medora couples in 1884-85, including James and Julia Butler and John Munro and Anne Brophy, and arranged a St. Patrick's Day ball and new pews for the church in 1885.
